title: RR EDGE Explainable Cricket Intelligence Architecture

framework_steps.name: Event Attribution & Match-State Reconstruction
framework_steps.description: Pre-delivery state calculation (balls remaining, score, required run rate, phase, wickets down) avoiding any outcome leakage.

framework_steps.name: Asymmetric Pressure Framework & First-Innings Resource Model
framework_steps.description: Independent batter and bowler pressure classifications into EXTREME, HIGH, MODERATE, and LOW tiers. In innings 1, par deficit is derived from FirstInningsResourceModel conditioned on Competition, Over bucket, and Wickets lost (no innings-phase conditioning).

framework_steps.name: Context Adjustment (RAE & RCAE)
framework_steps.description: Rate-normalized delivery performance relative to contextual expectations: Batter RAE (ΔSR) in strike-rate points ((Runs_obs - Runs_exp) / Balls * 100), Primary Bowler All-Runs RCAE (ΔEconomy) in runs per over ((All_Runs_obs - All_Runs_exp) / Legal Balls * 6) including wide and no-ball extras against legal exposure, and Secondary Diagnostic Legal-Ball RCAE (ΔLegal Economy) ((Legal_Runs_obs - Legal_Runs_exp) / Legal Balls * 6), conditioned on Competition type, Innings phase, and Wickets bucket.

framework_steps.name: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage & Uncertainty Bounds
framework_steps.description: Format-specific shrinkage across M=25, 45, 60, and 90, alongside 10,000-resample match-cluster bootstrap testing.

model_conditioning_variables.distinction_note: The first-innings resource grid conditions strictly on Competition, Over bucket, and Wickets lost; it does not use innings-phase conditioning.

shrinkage_grid.use_case: Conservative shrinkage preserving discovery ceiling for breakout talents
Primary recommended evaluation benchmark balancing upside and reliability
Holdout RMSE minimum empirically validated in holdout testing
Heavy shrinkage pulling small-sample performers towards cohort mean

evidence_tiers.criteria: >= 60 pressure balls across >= 8 matches and >= 2 competitions
evidence_tiers.reliability: High parameter stability; eligible for primary squad anchor roles
Moderate stability; suitable for role-specific rotational evaluation
High parameter uncertainty; exploratory scouting flag
